role: A no-lookahead half-month single-contract directional oil strategy whose appointed research director continuously weights forecast reversion and path continuation, deploys only allocated capital, passes through company risk, and settles through capacity-constrained weekly execution with exact TCA.
invariants: strategy decisions read only the visible market, published forecast, account state, appointed strategy and execution profiles, optional development-only turnover override, and trailing fee state
the appointed continuation-reversion preference changes signal composition but never reads the realized future regime
capital deployment uses only strategy capital already allocated by the investment-decision owner; public market limits are applied afterward as hard ceilings
company risk approval runs after strategy intent and before execution; it can preserve or shrink each target but can never enlarge it or reverse its sign
configured research-institution capability scores never enter strategy style, signal, position sizing, fill, or execution-cost formulas
the player-facing service chooses appointed generated personnel and never accepts free-form strategy radar values
execution ability never changes forecast signals or ideal target-position intent
market contract margin rates, position limits, execution capacity, hard fees, spreads and base slippage remain external owners
holding patience can retain an existing same-direction target but can never expand it beyond the resolved risk capacity
weekly allocation weights, expected net edge, budget utilization, cost estimates, and fee tier are frozen at the decision cutoff
realized weekly OHLC and volume enter only settlement-time fill penetration, spread, slippage, and PnL attribution
net adjustment and round trips share one published gross execution capacity
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
TCA compares actual execution with score-50 execution on the same realized orders and excludes hard cash-settlement fees
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, market open interest, forecasts, or macro rows
